rubric.role_summary: Data Scientist developing data products, models, reporting, and insights for finance-related product and business decisions, working with product, engineering, design, and business teams.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Data Scientist developing data products, models, reporting, and insights for finance-related product and business decisions, working with product, engineering, design, and business teams.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- Minimum of 4 years of industry experience as a Data Scientist.
- SQL proficiency.
- Experience with BI tools or dashboards.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- SQL experience with Redshift, Snowflake, or BigQuery.
- Familiarity with Looker, Omni, Sigma, Hex, or an equivalent BI tool.
- Experience with the modern data stack, such as Fivetran, Snowflake, dbt, Looker, Hightouch, or equivalents.
- Perspective on the analytics engineering development cycle.
- Experience in payments and financial technology.
- Familiarity with B2B enterprise sales cycle metrics and processes.
- Strong SQL knowledge and ability to write efficient SQL queries.
- Familiarity with BI tools and experience distributing data insights via reports and dashboards.
- Track record of shipping products or features at scale.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): New York metropolitan area; San Francisco Bay Area, California; US. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Remote candidates must currently be located in one of these areas; remote work does not remove this geographic condition.
